defs: n	erect or decumbent old world perennial with axillary clusters of rosy-purple flowers
n	Soft Italian or Italian-style cheese made from cow's or buffalo's milk.
adj	(informal) Overdramatic, excessively emotional or clichéd.
adj	Of or relating to cheese.
n	The part of milk that coagulates when it sours or is treated with enzymes.
v	(intransitive) To form curd; to curdle.
n	The coagulated part of any liquid.
